tasks.summary: The control that has the focus is entirely hidden by other content.

solution.summary: Add scroll-padding-top for the sticky header.
steps: Add scroll-padding-top: 96px to the html rule in globals.css.
solution.expected_result: The focused control is visible under the header on a backward Tab.

verify.expected: The rule focus-entirely-hidden gives no occurrence on the pages of the issue, and the issue is resolved in the next check.
